create.name: Don Reed Simmons
create.bio:
Don Reed Simmons is an American meditation teacher, sound practitioner and intuitive reader who grew up on a farm in the American South and later worked in film and as a crisis counsellor in New York, Los Angeles and Honolulu. He traces his spiritual path to a near-drowning while diving in Hawaii in the 1970s and to a Hawaiian kahuna he describes meeting in meditation, which shaped a shamanic practice he has taught since 2005. He names Thich Nhat Hanh and Jon Kabat-Zinn among his meditation teachers, trained in past-life regression with Brian Weiss, and holds an honorary doctorate from the Universal Life Church.

Much of his work centres on sound. He led the International Sound Therapy Association, a non-profit, as its elected president, has made recordings of sound and meditation, and co-created Sacred Sound Ministry, a training that helps churches and spiritual groups use gongs, bowls and voice in their services. He gives readings that draw on tarot, numerology and intuition, by phone, Zoom or in person, offers one-to-one sound sessions for relaxation and stress, and hosts The Mindful Society podcast. He has led meditation and sound events in the Atlanta area and now spends time in Sarasota, Florida.

healer.no_public_base: His site names no base; Sarasota was only inferred from his About page saying he sails there.

courses.title: Intuitive Readings
courses.description: One-to-one readings by phone, Zoom or in person, usually about an hour, in which he combines his own way of throwing the tarot cards with numerology and intuitive insight. Sessions look at life direction, relationships, work and timing.

courses.title: Sound Therapy Sessions
courses.description: Private or group sound sessions with gongs, Himalayan and crystal bowls and tuning forks, placed on and around the body and joined with guided meditation. He offers them for relaxation and stress reduction.

courses.title: Sacred Sound Ministry
courses.description: A three-day intensive, first run at Unity North Atlanta, that trains members of a congregation or spiritual group to use bowls, gongs, bells, tuning forks and voice in worship and outreach. No musical background is needed.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @donreed.simmons 90 subscribers and @donreedsimmons 553 subscribers (YouTube Data API, 12 Nov 2026); Instagram not fetched (off limits) → ~643 readable → local_hero
flags: Health restore (owner's 12 Nov rule): his main work is intuitive readings, sound sessions and meditation, which pass. His site's main menu still carries an 'Addiction and Depression Services' page and an AMI 750 sound-device page telling how he avoided knee surgery with it; both are left out, but the menu stays visible from website_url. Owner may prefer to drop him.
He calls himself a medical intuitive on his About and readings pages; the readings item is described without that framing.
Base: his About page says he sails around Sarasota, Florida and he runs psychicsrq.com; no line says 'based in'. Recorded as Sarasota, Florida; earlier events were in Atlanta, Georgia.
Photos: his site is on Wix (static.wixstatic.com refuses us), so both photos are his own YouTube channel avatars, looked at: the same man.
Brand inbox: none; the address is his own gmail, published as a mailto on several pages.
Two YouTube channels of his own (@donreedsimmons, 2007, and @donreed.simmons, 2015); youtube_url is the newer one with his meditations.
Dry run not run: the ingest dry run is refused by this session's permission system; images were downloaded with curl (200, 800×800) and looked at.
left_out: Sound Therapy for Addiction and Depression (page in his main menu): sold as help for named conditions and quotes a doctor on treating 'virtually any medical disorder' (health rule).
AMI 750 sound device page: personal story of healing a torn meniscus instead of surgery (health rule, replacing medical care).
Design Hypnosis ($250): the page leans on quotes about hypnosis for weight loss, pain and anxiety; weight-loss framing (diet rule).
Visionary Business Consultants (psychic business consulting): business service, not spiritual teaching.
1 Minute Meditation videos (312k views, 1:00): under the ~2 minute minimum.

2020–2021 livestream meditations on @donreed.simmons (Prayer of St Francis, Stay Strong, Breaking Free…): made during the pandemic and their descriptions couldn't be checked for COVID content without opening YouTube pages.
FOX 5 Atlanta clip 'How to use sound and meditation for healing' (2:48): a news segment on a TV channel.
Atlanta event pages (June and July 2026): past.
